title: Pooled training for the v8.2 ridge: learn from 18 coins (BTC, ETH + 16 Upbit altcoins), trade BTC / ETH only
registered: 2026-10-21, after Gen288 / 289, before any Gen290 number
model: v8.2 ridge unchanged (features, kimchi breadth, volatility-scaled target, monthly walk-forward, alpha 10, prediction / in-sample sd clipped +-1, position 0.5 x prediction for BTC / ETH) except the training rows: BTC and ETH plus the 16 altcoins, with the same features computed per coin (zc where a Coinbase USD market exists, zk = the coin's own kimchi z, dvol1 missing for altcoins -> standardised 0, is_eth 0 for altcoins). Predictions are made and traded for BTC and ETH only
why: with volatility-scaled targets the coins' returns are comparable, so 9x more training rows can stabilise the coefficients
